title: Integrate Manager-owned shared memory and iPhone intake contract
summary: Connected participant-specific Sheets memory responsibilities to roles, entry points, continuation and acceptance documents. Preserved existing local reference runtime.
outcome: Documentation and cross-repository parity checked; 66 local tests and 37 synthetic CLI commands passed. Fifteen new memory scenarios are specifications, not live passes.
decisions: Manager owns participant-specific structure and logging duties; fixed tabs are not prescribed
All roles record scoped work and exchanges; runtime receipts remain distinct from assertions
Local single-writer behavior is separate from future cloud implementation
next_actions: Implement and verify the chosen cloud intake and memory adapter in an authorized host
